notes.title: Update Game Engine Version
notes.notes:
Game Engine: Godot 4.4 => Godot 4.5

Added auxiliary lines to make it easier to distinguish the line being operated.

notes.title: Update Setting UI
notes.notes:
When changing settings with a controller (or keyboard), the currently selected item will now be displayed with a yellow border.

Also, if there are items that cannot be changed due to other settings, the selection of those items will be skipped.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297801/bcf247c843d2d852d39bb18c808c7880efe5a543.png"]

notes.title: Graphics Update
notes.notes:
The animation at the bottom of the screen has been changed from white line drawing to color.

notes.title: bugfix: bonus notifications
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where bonus notifications were not brought to the top order.

notes.title: Update: Screen layout
notes.notes:
The screen layout has been revised and the animation area has been split into left and right.
Also, the bonus display has been updated to make it easier to see that the score is boosted by the bonus.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297801/25b4f173c07bd56d512bd687091ecddd46e5cb65.png

The displayed message and score will change depending on the chain state.

notes.title: Resource Management Update
notes.notes: To prevent delays in rendering updates, some resources are now loaded in the background.
